en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, ornate brick courthouse complex with steep tiled roofs, gables, and decorative façades. The main building has a tall central section with large arched windows and elaborate roof detail. Another connected building stands to the left. A fence and trees line the front, and a broad street runs along the bottom where two small children are visible on the sidewalk. The caption at the top left reads "Rosswein – Amtsgericht".
